features: 【Wireless Connectivity】Full-Size Wireless Keyboard with ₹ Symbol – 104-key layout designed for comfortable typing, featuring a dedicated Rupee (₹) key for quick billing, accounting, and everyday office use.
【Retractable Stand Design】Adjustable tilt legs provide a comfortable typing angle, reducing wrist strain during long working hours at home or office.
【Durable Construction】Durable UV-Coated Keycaps – Advanced UV coating prevents key fading and wear, ensuring long-lasting print clarity even after heavy daily usage
【Smart Power Saving Mode】Automatic sleep function conserves battery life when idle, making it energy efficient and ideal for long-term use.
【Smart Auto Connect】Automatically Establishes A Stable Connection Between The Keyboard, Mouse, And Your Device Without The Need For Manual Pairing.
【Retro Style Keyboard Design 】Traditional layout with comfortable key spacing for a familiar typing experience, perfect for professionals and regular users.
【4 Button Mouse】1600 DPI Adjustable Mouse With Dedicated DPI Button. Mouse Is Ergonomic, Buttons Are Responsive & Durable, Powered By 1x AAA Battery.

description: The TAG KBWM1200 Wireless Keyboard and Mouse Combo Kit offers a seamless, efficient, and comfortable computing experience with its sleek design and advanced functionality. Featuring a full-sized keyboard with 104 standard keys, this combo kit is perfect for users who require both retro look and convenience. The keys on the keyboard are standard size with a sealed membrane design, providing a smooth typing experience and enhanced durability. With a remarkable 10 million keystroke lifespan, the keyboard is built to withstand heavy use, making it ideal for both office and home settings. This combo kit is designed for ease of use and is compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux operating systems, ensuring broad versatility. The keyboard and mouse connect effortlessly via a 2.4GHz nano receiver, offering a reliable wireless connection with a range of up to 10 meters, perfect for maintaining a clutter-free workspace. The keyboard is powered by two AA batteries, and both the keyboard and mouse come with energy-saving auto power-off modes to conserve battery life when not in use. The ergonomic design of both the keyboard and mouse ensures comfort during extended use, reducing strain on you
